college_name: St. Ann's College of Engineering & Technology (SACET)
motto: Leading to the Heights of Technical Excellence
accreditation: Accredited by NAAC with 'A' Grade (Twice Accredited), NBA Accredited Departments (CSE, ECE, EEE, MECH), ISO 9001:2015 Certified
affiliation: Autonomous Institution, Permanently Affiliated to Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Kakinada (JNTUK), Approved by AICTE & UGC, New Delhi

campus_overview.location: Nayunipalli, Challareddy Palem, Vetapalem Mandal, near Chirala, Bapatla District, Andhra Pradesh - 523187
campus_overview.campus_area: Sprawling 35+ Acres eco-friendly green campus with modern engineering blocks
campus_overview.vision: To develop St. Ann’s College of Engineering and Technology into an institution of global standards catering to the educational needs of students and contributing to the welfare of the local community.
campus_overview.mission: To deliver quality education at undergraduate and postgraduate levels by adopting best teaching-learning practices; providing faculty development and research opportunities; fostering industry-institution interactions for training and placements; and managing the institution with transparent governance while supporting community well-being.

cse_data_science.department_overview: Established in 2021 with an intake of 60 under AICTE approval. Data Science is the study of large amount of data to extract meaningful insights for decision-making combining mathematics, statistics, AI, and computer engineering.
cse_data_science.curriculum_and_regulation: Autonomous R26 and R23 Regulation approved by Board of Studies (BOS). Focuses on Big Data Analytics, Cloud Computing, Predictive Modeling, and Machine Learning.

official_fee_structure_afrc.regulatory_body: Andhra Pradesh Higher Education Regulatory & Monitoring Commission (APHERMC / AFRC)
official_fee_structure_afrc.government_fee_reimbursement: 100% Full Tuition Fee Reimbursement for eligible BC, SC, ST, EWS, and Kapu students qualifying under Andhra Pradesh Government Jagananna Vidya Deevena (JVD) scheme.
official_fee_structure_afrc.fee_refund_policy: Full refund (minus processing fee up to Rs. 1,000) if withdrawn prior to course commencement. Pro-rated refund if withdrawn post-commencement and seat is subsequently filled.

training_and_placement_cell.officer: Mr. N. Purna Chandra Rao (M.B.A., M.Phil., Ph.D scholar at VIT Vellore)

academic_regulations.regulations: Autonomous R26 (Latest 2026 Curriculum), R23, R22, R20
academic_regulations.attendance_rule: 75% minimum mandatory attendance required to qualify for semester-end examinations (Condonation up to 10% on medical grounds approved by Principal).
academic_regulations.mentor_mentee_system: 1 mentor faculty assigned per 20 students for continuous academic and personal counseling.
academic_regulations.credits_system: Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) with semester grade point average (SGPA) and cumulative grade point average (CGPA).

hostels.boys_and_girls: Separate residential hostel campuses for Boys and Girls on campus with round-the-clock security, RO purified water, study halls, mess serving hygienic food, and strictly enforced 8:00 PM curfew.

transport.fleet: 30+ College Buses operating across Chirala, Vetapalem, Bapatla, Parchur, Karamchedu, Singarayakonda, Inkollu, and Ongole. Free transportation provided for college faculty members.

library.collection: Central Digital Library with 50,000+ volumes, DELNET membership, IEEE online research subscriptions, and 50+ computer systems for digital e-learning.

sports.grounds: Sprawling outdoor grounds for Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Basketball, Kabaddi, plus a modern Gymnasium supervised by Physical Education Director Sri Annam Srinivasa Rao.

live_bulletins_2026.headline: 23(A) Bn NCC CATC-I Camp & Firing Practice
live_bulletins_2026.description: 10-day Combined Annual Training Camp for NCC Cadets organized at SACET Nayunipalli campus with live rifle firing sessions at the college firing range under Lieutenant M. Rajesh Babu.

live_bulletins_2026.headline: PACE Festino State Volleyball Champions & Kabaddi Runners-Up
live_bulletins_2026.description: SACET Men Volleyball team won the prestigious State-level Champions Trophy at PACE Festino 2026, while the Kabaddi team secured Runners-Up under Physical Director Sri Annam Srinivasa Rao.

live_bulletins_2026.headline: Strategic 3-Year Drone MoU Signed with Ramsur Agri LLP
live_bulletins_2026.description: Formal agreement signed between SACET Chirala and Ramsur Agri LLP for setting up an on-campus agricultural drone assembly lab, DGCA-compliant pilot training, and student internships.

live_bulletins_2026.headline: APSSDC 5-Day Power BI & Data Analytics Workshop
live_bulletins_2026.description: Intensive hands-on workshop conducted by APSSDC for engineering students covering data cleaning, DAX, predictive analytics, and executive business dashboards.

live_bulletins_2026.headline: CSE & CSI ServiceNow Certification Course
live_bulletins_2026.description: Professional tool certification course organized by CSE Dept (HOD Dr. P. Harini, Coordinator T. Shesha Sai) in partnership with the Computer Society of India and Next Gen Secunderabad.

live_bulletins_2026.headline: Free POLYCET Entrance Coaching & Free Bus Facility
live_bulletins_2026.description: Free coaching, syllabus books, and free bus service from Chirala/Bapatla for 10th class students aspiring to join diploma engineering. (Coordinator: Dr. K. Vijay Bhaskara Reddy, 9505518288).
